{{Quote|Report carried out by forensic science commander V2A DAZ|Forensic report on Onaconda Farr|<ref name="Senate Murders">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref>}}
'''V2A DAZ''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that served as a forensic science commander for the [[Forensics Unit]] in the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Following the death of [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], the droid made a report on the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian's]] autopsy.

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The name of the science commander is only identified through the all-[[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] forensic report held by [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] [[Inspector/Legends|inspector]] [[Tan Divo/Legends|Tan Divo]]. The report says:

:: "FORENSIC REPORT ''[two blurred digits]''77"<br />

:: "[[Onaconda Farr/Legends|ONACONDA FARR]]" <br />

:: "REPORT CARRIED OUT BY <br />
:: FORENSIC [[Scientist/Legends|SCIENCE]] COMMANDER <br />
:: V2A DAZ" <br />

:: "NAME" : "ONACONDA FARR" <br />

:: "[[Species/Legends|RACE]]" : "[[Rodian/Legends|RODIAN]]" <br />

:: "CAUSE OF [[Death/Legends|DEATH]]" : "[[Poison/Legends|POISON]]"<br />

:: "POISON ORIGIN" : "[[Kamino/Legends|KAMINO]]" <br />

:: "TESTS CARRIED OUT ON <br />
:: POISON INDICATES THAT <br />
:: THIS POISON WAS ONLY <br />
:: EFFECTIVE ON RODIAN [[Blood/Legends|BLOOD]]"<br />
